explanation: The theorem is specific to the library: three additive endomorphisms F, Fs, δ with F∘Fs = Fs∘F = p•id, F commuting with δ, and δ w = Fs (Fs w). By induction on k it proves both δ^[k](F^[2k] w) = p^(2k) • w and that the relation δ = Fs∘Fs persists at F^[2k] w. The induction step uses the library's own lemma key_step. The only Mathlib lemmas involved are general iterate and smul lemmas (Function.iterate_succ_apply', iterate_map_zsmul', smul_smul), which do not carry this content. Mathlib's iterate-commutation lemmas (Function.Commute.iterate_*, iterate_map_zsmul) are only ingredients: deriving the statement from them still needs a real induction, not a one- or two-line instantiation.
